title: Orchestrated standby surge failure simulation and restore proofs
creator: Samira Patel
description: Goal: Run a scheduled, instrumented active->passive failover simulation that exercises standby warmup, circuit-breaker-triggered graceful shedding, and end-to-end restore validation proof points. Deliverables: 1) A step-by-step runbook for operations that can be executed with a 90-minute SLA for recovery assertions; 2) Automated smoke tests that validate KV snapshot integrity post-restore; 3) Dashboard panels and alerts for SLO regressions triggered by the drill; 4) A post-mortem template capturing divergence windows and corrective actions.
comments: 2026-01-12 - Samira Patel: Kickoff. Scope approved by SRE lead. Targeting a mid-sized tenant workload that represents 5% of production RPS to limit blast radius. Will coordinate maintenance window with Platform Ops.

2026-01-15 - Diego Marquez: Draft runbook uploaded (GDrive: https://drive.company.internal/DR/ENG-273900-runbook). Draft includes pre-checks, snapshot export, promotion sequence, KV drift assertions, and rollback criteria.
2026-01-18 - Priya Rao (PM): Added customer communication template and SLA guardrails. Confirmed legal/compliance notification not required for scheduled internal drill.

2026-01-20 - Diego Marquez: Perf test results from canary run: standby warmup median latency 140ms (target <120ms). Action: add pre-warm step to warmup cache and GPU kernels to meet latency SLO during promotion.

2026-01-22 - Elena Kuznetsov (SRE reviewer): Circuit breaker simulation validated. Two threshold experiments: (a) aggressive CB (trip at 60% error budget) -> graceful shedding observed; (b) conservative CB (trip at 90%) -> partial cascading latency. Recommendation: use conservative CB in live drill, aggressive in chaos lab.

2026-01-25 - Diego Marquez: Snapshot/restore proof harness implemented. Harness runs: export snapshot, restore to isolated cluster, run deterministic KV checksum test and sample read-after-write across 10k keys. Results: checksums matched for all runs in the harness (links to CI: https://ci.company.internal/DR/273900).

2026-01-28 - Samira Patel: Added failure injection step: simulate control-plane delay and zone-level packet loss. Documented expected telemetry (error rate, p50/p95/p99 latencies, queue length) and abort conditions (error rate > 10% for 5m without progress).
2026-01-30 - Diego Marquez: Coordination with Console team for SLO dashboards. Created runtime and request-token panels; alert rule: SLO breach delta > 3% within 15m triggers drill halt and rollback.

2026-02-01 - Samira Patel: Readout from tabletop rehearsal. Actions: (1) tighten rollback gating to include KV checksum failures, (2) move golden snapshot validation earlier in sequence, (3) assign run captain and run scribe. Preparing final runbook for exec review.

Next steps: finalize runbook, schedule maintenance window, run closed-lab aggressive CB experiment, then run controlled production drill using conservative CB settings. Prepare post-drill postmortem template and remediation backlog.
